content.short: Blockchain UCLA is a student-run organization facilitating blockchain education and innovation.
content.description: Blockchain UCLA offers UCLA students a structured path to learn blockchain technology and develop applications on top of it. It provides educational resources and hands-on experiences building blockchain-based solutions to illustrate real-world use cases. The program helps students expand their knowledge, connect with active blockchain communities, and explore job opportunities in the blockchain space, fostering networking and practical skills for the next generation of developers.
